newsitem.title: USA: CME expands strike range for live cattle options.
newsitem.headline: CME expands strike range for live cattle options.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange has expanded the strike price range for Live Cattle options to 14 cents from 10 cents effective with the beginning of trade on Tuesday, January 7, a CME release stated.
The move comes after the CME's Agricultural Oversight Committee approved a recommendation from the Agricultural Options Committee to expand the strike price range.
A CME official said the change was in response to customers who had requested the range expansion.
